newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down before weekend.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down before weekend.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Friday on unloading of blue chips before the Saturday and Sunday weekend, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange said.
The Karachi 100-share index closed 1.12 points, or 0.07 percent, down at 1,546.15.

Hub Power Co Ltd closed 0.10 lower at 37.80 after the company denied a newspaper report that the Water and Power Development Authority had notified it that it was terminating its power purchase agreement. Dewan Salman fibre was 0.30 down at 36.15. Pakistan Telecommunication Co Ltd rose 0.50 to 25.70. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
